Brood patch.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Brood patch.question: The _____ was Area of bare skin on the underside of nesting birds.
Brood patch.fact: A brood patch, also called an incubation patch in older literature, is an area of featherless skin on the underside of birds that exists during the nesting season. Feathers act as inherent insulators and prevent efficient incubation, to which brood patches are the solution.

Broodiness.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
Broodiness.question: The _____ was Behavioral tendency to sit on a clutch of eggs to incubate them.
Broodiness.fact: Broodiness is the action or behavioral tendency to sit on a clutch of eggs to incubate them, often requiring the non-expression of many other behaviors including feeding and drinking.
